title: Report API Key Status in Config
description: Teach the config loader to report whether the API key is set and log a missing key once.
deliverable: config exposes apiKeyConfigured and logs a missing key at startup

title: Expose API Key Flag on Status Endpoint
description: Add api_key_configured to /api/status without returning the key.
deliverable: /api/status returns api_key_configured and never the key
depends_on: Report API Key Status in Config

title: Fetch Status Flag on Page Load
deliverable: public and landing pages read api_key_configured on load
depends_on: Expose API Key Flag on Status Endpoint

title: Display Notice for Missing API Key
description: Render a notice explaining how to set the key when the flag is false.
deliverable: a visible notice on both pages when the key is missing, hidden otherwise
depends_on: Fetch Status Flag on Page Load

derived_criteria.text: Both public/index.html and landing/index.html display a visible notice when the API key is missing
derived_criteria.reason: the user asked for the notice on both pages
